rationale: The change explicitly extends the Phenomenon of Interest scope beyond the baseline collision-relevant spatial situation by adding road-surface condition as part of what must be characterized to determine whether braking is required. The Evaluation Target remains unchanged, but the PoI scope changes, so the existing derivational basis is no longer fully applicable and derivation must resume at RR2. No existing ORR is simply revalidated because the baseline ORRs cover obstacle presence, object category, and ego-obstacle distance, not road-surface condition.
